description: The figure is a horizontal grouped bar chart illustrating the “Difference in Average WER from Whisper” for two fine-tuned models across several “optimisations applied.” The category axis is vertical and labeled “optimisations applied,” listing (top to bottom) Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The value axis is horizontal and labeled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 0.000, 0.001, 0.002, and 0.003. Each category contains two horizontally aligned bars distinguished by color and legend: an orange bar for “NESAC ft model” and a green bar for “SESHA ft model.” Approximate values are printed at the bar ends: for Normalised, orange is about 0.0035 and green about 0.0033; for Add Spacing, orange is about 0.0032 and green about 0.00344; for Remove Spacing, orange is about 0.00311 and green about 0.00306; for Americanisms, orange is about 0.00299 and green about 0.00302; and for Dates, orange is about 0.00257 and green about 0.00228. The bars are not shown as explicitly sorted by magnitude; they follow the listed category order, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the end-value annotations.
